That the decree was obtained by fraud and misrepresentation, the fraud being material and having induced the Court to pass the ex parte decree; such fraud falls within the ambit of Article 95 of the Limitation Act 1908, which provides a cause of action to set aside a decree obtained by fraud.  

That the fraud and misrepresentation were discovered by the plaintiff within the period prescribed by Article 95 Limitation Act 1908, and the plaintiff has filed this application within three years from the date such fraud became known, thereby satisfying the limitation period.  

That, pursuant to Order XXXVII Rule 4 CPC, the Court has the power, in special circumstances, to set aside a decree and, if necessary, stay or set aside its execution, and may grant leave to the defendant to appear and defend the suit.  

That the plaintiff is entitled to the relief sought under the foregoing provisions, namely the setting aside of the ex parte decree and any consequential orders.

raw:
APPLICATION UNDER SECTION 502 CRPC

1. That the Applicant, [NAME OF SURETY], is a surety who executed a bond for the attendance and appearance of the accused, [NAME OF ACCUSED], in the case bearing FIR No. ________, dated ________, before the [Name of Magistrate] Court, Sindh.

2. That the Applicant now seeks to be discharged from the said bond pursuant to Section 502 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, which provides that a surety may at any time apply to a Magistrate for discharge of the bond, either wholly or insofar as it relates to the applicant.

3. That the Applicant also relies upon Section 126 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, which authorises any surety for the peaceable conduct or good behaviour of another person to apply to the concerned Magistrate of the First Class to cancel any bond executed under this Chapter within the local limits of his jurisdiction.

4. That the Applicant has complied with all conditions of the bond and there is no pending liability or forfeiture that would prejudice the discharge.

5. That the Applicant respectfully requests that this Hon’ble Court issue a warrant directing the accused to appear before the Magistrate, as required under Section 502(2) CrPC, and thereafter order the discharge of the Applicant from all obligations under the bail bond.

PRAYER

The Applicant prays that this Hon’ble Court may be pleased to:

a) Issue a warrant of arrest directing the accused to appear before the Magistrate as per Section 502(2) CrPC; and

b) Discharge the Applicant from the bail bond executed in favour of the accused, in accordance with Sections 502 and 126 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898; and

c) Pass such further order(s) as may be deemed just and proper.
